symbols.read: The bearish read is confirmed and extended: price at 733.34 remains below the 737.02 invalidation and the 1H downtrend persists, with a fresh bear FVG at 737.63–738.00 now reinforcing the overhead supply alongside 745.09–746.32. The SELL setup at 722.40 is armed but still pending — price has not yet broken the lower pivot, so the 686.36 target remains contingent on that trigger. Bias stays bearish-leaning with 4H now flipped to bearish, aligning with the combined SELL signal. Invalidation is unchanged: a reclaim of 737.02 and the 745.09–746.32 FVG would void the bearish read; holding below 737.02 keeps 722.40 and then 686.36 in play.

The bearish lean is confirmed and extended again: price has slid from 81,967.91 to 81,754.71, with the last 1H bar down -0.36% (82,041.44→81,750.01) and the 1H trend now explicitly down, while the 4H stays bearish and the combined 4H+1H reading holds at SELL. The BUY setup is flagged INVALIDATED — its 82,413.00 stop sits above current price, so the long is dead and the regime BULLISH tag is stale relative to the tape. A new bear FVG at 82,267.79–82,465.00 has opened just overhead, stacking with the existing 82,531–82,647 and 83,015–83,404 gaps to cap any bounce, so bias remains bearish toward the 80,684.36 lower pivot. Invalidation of the bearish case still requires a full reclaim of the 83,713.91 pivot and the 83,484–84,082.82 gap; a first repair signal would be reclaiming 82,647 and then the 83,015–83,404 gap.

The bearish bias remains confirmed and has extended further: price at 2,403.73 is now below the prior read's 2,409.41, with the 1H trend still down (2,406.46→2,400.34) and the combined 4H+1H signal still SELL. The 2,453.97–2,472.90 bear FVG remains the only open overhead supply, now even more distant, while the 2,329.00 lower pivot stays the downside magnet. The BUY setup (entry 2,478.00, stop 2,481.87, target 2,627.00) is explicitly invalidated and irrelevant at this price. Invalidation of the bearish read still requires a reclaim of 2,478.00 and a close through the overhead FVG; the BULLISH regime tag remains stale and contradicted by structure.

Price has rebounded to 104.49 from the prior 103.82, a modest recovery that leaves the bearish structure intact but shifts the immediate picture: the newest bear FVG at 104.68–104.72 has been broken through to the upside, and a fresh bull FVG at 104.33–104.45 has opened beneath price, giving the bounce a foothold. The bear stack overhead has reorganized into five gaps with a new top at 107.55–107.90, while the 1H trend remains down and the combined read downgraded from SELL to HOLD, so the bearish bias is now softened rather than confirmed. Bias is neutral-to-bearish: 100.43 remains the downside magnet and 108.25 the upside pivot, with a hold above 108.25 still the invalidation that would neutralize the stacked gaps and revive the 116.07 target. The BUY setup stays invalidated and moot at entry 108.25, far above price.

Price has extended the bearish leg to 55.75 from 55.85, and the 1H trend remains down, confirming the prior bearish bias — the layered bear FVGs between 56.79 and 57.47 remain overhead supply and price is now within 0.38 of the 55.37 target. The short entry/stop cluster (58.41/58.58) stays EXPIRED and far above price, so the original entry remains fully stale; combined stays SELL with 4H bearish. Bias remains bearish toward 55.37, with the invalidation unchanged: a sustained reclaim of 58.41 flips the read bullish toward 61.45.

The bearish thesis reached its 4,065.48 target and overshot to 4,059.72, so the prior read's call was correct on direction but the setup is now flagged INVALIDATED — the trade has hit its objective and there is no fresh short edge at this price. The 1H leg accelerated to -0.50% (from -0.11%), confirming momentum re-expanded into the target rather than softening, while the stacked bear FVGs at 4,126.37–4,130.31 and 4,131.15–4,132.33 remain untouched overhead supply. Bias stays bearish structurally (4H bearish, combined SELL, regime BEARISH), but with price ~82 points below the 4,141.44 pivot, the invalidation line is far overhead and no longer a meaningful near-term trigger. The actionable pivot is now 4,065.48 as flipped resistance — a sustained reclaim above it would signal the target-driven sell-off is exhausting, while holding below keeps pressure toward further downside extension.

Bias stays bearish and is now confirmed rather than just flipping: the combined 4H+1H stance has moved from HOLD to SELL, with the 4H direction bearish and the 1H trend down, while price holds at 1.33 below the 1.35 upper pivot. The bear FVG at 1.3532–1.3633 remains the active overhead supply and the 1.35 line in the sand is now resistance; the 1.26 lower pivot is the downside objective, and the expired BUY with a 1.44 target stays off the table. The only change from the prior read is the stance upgrade to SELL and the flat 1.33→1.33 close, which keeps price pinned under supply without yet extending toward 1.26. Invalidation is unchanged: a reclaim of 1.3633 would be the first sign of repair, and a sustained hold below 1.33 keeps the path to 1.26 open.
